message: Astra: Within Ya na’s scene, does your revised gesture resolve what you called “Exact Position and Posture,” or does some uncertainty still affect readability? Which remaining words deserve attention rather than another whole-scene rewrite? What would further thinking establish that an informative writing attempt would not, and what unresolved choice could make attempting it premature? Can you briefly state your finding, remaining uncertainty, and chosen next intention in English, then carry it out so we can examine the actual change?
speaker: Astra
